title: Mount Batur Sunrise 4WD Jeep, Black Lava & Natural Hot Spring Tour

infoSections.title: Before You Book
content: Minimum booking of 1 participant is required to confirm the reservation.
Private hotel pick-up and drop-off is included across major tourist areas including Kuta, Seminyak, Legian, Canggu, Sanur, Ubud, Nusa Dua, and Jimbaran.
Your English-speaking private driver will greet you directly in your hotel lobby holding a personalized name sign.
This excursion involves an off-road 4WD ride; it is not recommended for pregnant women or travelers with severe back conditions.
Mount Batur elevation is around 1,365 meters above sea level, where predawn temperatures can fall between 10°C to 15°C (50°F - 59°F).
Child seats are available upon advance request at no additional charge.
What to bring: Warm fleece or jacket, comfortable long pants, closed-toe walking shoes, swimwear, clean change of clothes, camera or smartphone, and extra cash for personal expenses.
Weather notice: Mountain weather in Kintamani can change quickly; while sunrise views are typical, cloud coverage and atmospheric conditions are governed by nature.

infoSections.title: Other Think You Have To Know
content: Enjoy full flexibility with a 100% refund for cancellations submitted at least 24 hours prior to scheduled pick-up time.
In the event of severe inclement weather posing safety risks, alternative tour arrangements or complete refunds will be provided.
A 30% deposit is secured via bank transfer, Wise, or Remitly at the time of reservation to confirm your private 4x4 Jeep.
The remaining balance may be settled conveniently in USD or IDR cash upon pick-up with your driver.
Comprehensive travel accident insurance is included for all registered participants throughout the duration of the tour.

description: Escape the predawn chill and venture up the rugged volcanic slopes of Mount Batur aboard an authentic open-roof 4WD classic Jeep. Watch the world slowly awaken as brilliant hues of amber, violet, and gold illuminate the sacred caldera, Lake Batur, and distant Mount Rinjani. Afterward, traverse the stark and dramatic expanse of ancient black lava flows formed by historic volcanic eruptions. Conclude your mountain adventure with a deeply soothing soak in natural lakeside hot springs, letting the thermal mineral waters rejuvenate your body and spirit. Complete your journey with an aromatic tasting flight of artisanal coffees and teas nestled within lush jungle scenery.
highlights: Witness an unforgettable golden sunrise over Mount Batur from an exclusive high-altitude viewpoint without strenuous hiking
Ride across rugged mountain terrains in an iconic open-top 4WD vintage Jeep guided by an expert local driver
Explore the dramatic volcanic landscape and otherworldly rock fields of the historic 1963 Black Lava flow
Melt your stress away in natural thermal hot spring pools situated right at the edge of Lake Batur
Savor complimentary hot drinks and breakfast at dawn, followed by a visit to a traditional organic spice plantation
exclusions: Personal expenses, souvenirs, and additional snacks or alcoholic beverages
Tipping and gratuities for your driver and local Jeep guide
Luwak coffee tasting fee (available for optional upgrade on-site)

itinerary.description: Your professional driver meets you at your accommodation in a comfortable, air-conditioned private vehicle. Relax and rest during the scenic early-morning drive winding up into the tranquil highlands of Kintamani.
itinerary.title: Pick up from the hotel

pickup.description: Pick up from your hotel at 03:00

itinerary.title: Transfer to 4WD Jeep at Base Camp
itinerary.description: Arrive at the Kintamani base camp where your specialized mountain 4WD Jeep driver welcomes you. Receive a short safety briefing before climbing aboard your rugged vintage 4x4 Jeep for the exhilarating ascent through pine forests and mountain trails.

itinerary.title: Mount Batur Sunrise Viewing & Breakfast
itinerary.description: Park at a prime panoramic sunrise deck perched high on the volcano's eastern flank. Enjoy a freshly prepared light breakfast with warm coffee or hot tea while watching the sun rise above a magical blanket of clouds, framing Mount Abang and Mount Rinjani.

Descend along craggy volcanic paths into the monumental Black Lava basin sculpted by the historic 1963 eruption. Explore towering volcanic formations, marvel at the raw geological power of Batur, and take extraordinary off-road photos.
itinerary.title: Off-Road Black Lava Adventure

itinerary.description: Immerse yourself in steaming mineral-rich thermal springs perched on the shores of Lake Batur, soothing tired muscles while gazing at the towering crater walls. Afterwards, visit a lush jungle plantation to sample freshly roasted Balinese coffees and fragrant spices.
itinerary.title: Batur Natural Hot Springs & Coffee Plantation

itinerary.description: Sit back and unwind in your private air-conditioned vehicle as your driver transports you safely back down the highlands. Return smoothly to your hotel lobby with unforgettable mountain memories and camera rolls filled with golden hour vistas.
itinerary.title: Back to hotel

importantInfo: Please wear warm layers, a windbreaker jacket, and sturdy closed-toe walking shoes as early morning mountain temperatures can drop significantly. Bring swimwear, a change of clothes, sunscreen, sunglasses, and a camera to capture the stunning scenery.
